git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - architectural debt accumulated over multiple commits
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Session recovery was split across 5 components (bash watcher, ExecStartPre/Post, post-start script, daemon respawn) with tangled ownership, causing Bug #60 (flock race) and Bug #61 (cross-daemon cascade)
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Consolidates all recovery into the daemon TypeScript process: snapshot writes on every lifecycle event + periodic 60s safety net + startup restore from snapshot. Single source of truth eliminates cross-component coordination bugs.

implementation_notes: configuration.ts was refactored to extract 5 helper functions from the constructor to pass the quality gate (max 30 lines per function). Functionality is identical.
run.ts has 8 persistSnapshot() call sites covering all session lifecycle events plus periodic safety writes.
The startup restore waits 5 seconds between session spawns to avoid resource contention (matches proven bash script timing).
PID file is now self-written by the daemon, replacing the Python-based approach in happy-daemon-post-start.sh.
Part B (systemd service generation) was already fully implemented - linux/install.ts, linux/uninstall.ts, parseInstallArgs.ts, and CLI routing in index.ts all existed and are correct.
